'''2017 Worlds Drops Jeremy Gardner DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Gardner]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Drops).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeremy Gardner]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Drops
